name: Bulk Upsell & Cross-Sell Editor
author: Mateusz

sections.description:
Tired of opening dozens of product pages just to link a few upsells or cross-sells? The Bulk Upsell & Cross-Sell Editor provides a fast, intuitive table-based editor right in your WooCommerce dashboard.

Key Features

  • Fast Bulk Editing: Add or remove upsells and cross-sells for multiple products at once.
  • Dynamic Product Search: Instantly search for products by name or SKU to link them.
  • Custom Cross-Sell Discounts: Offer a percentage discount on a cross-sell product, but only when the “trigger” product is in the cart.
  • Variation Support: Edit linked products for individual product variations.
  • Intuitive Interface: A clean, filterable table makes managing your product relationships simple.

This plugin is designed to save you time and help you increase your average order value through strategic product recommendations.

💡 Pro Tip: Don’t just guess what sells well together. Use ApusNest to run a full Market Basket Analysis and discover your store’s most profitable product combinations scientifically.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bulk-upsell-cross-sell-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Bulk Linked Products to start editing.

short_description: A plugin to bulk edit WooCommerce up-sells and cross-sells with custom discount offers, all from a single, powerful interface.
